report_name: Singapore Police Warn of iMessage Phishing Scam Costing $1.2M+

threat_actors.name: Unidentified iMessage Phishing Scammers
threat_actors.description: An unidentified group of scammers conducting a widespread phishing campaign on Apple iMessage, impersonating courier companies to steal financial credentials from victims in Singapore.
threat_actors.goals: To steal credit card and banking credentials for financial theft.

attack_patterns.name: Spearphishing Link
attack_patterns.description: Scammers sent iMessages containing a malicious link under the guise of a failed parcel delivery notification from courier companies like DHL and SingPost.

attack_patterns.name: Phishing for Information
attack_patterns.description: The campaign's goal was to elicit sensitive information by directing victims to a spoofed website to enter their full credit card details and internet banking login credentials.

attack_patterns.name: Impersonation
attack_patterns.description: The threat actors impersonated major courier services such as DHL, NinjaVan, and SingPost to gain the victims' trust and trick them into clicking the phishing link.

campaigns.name: Singapore iMessage Courier Phishing Scam
campaigns.description: A prolific phishing campaign starting in June 2026 that targets Apple iMessage users in Singapore. The scam involves impersonating courier companies to lure victims to fraudulent websites and harvest their financial credentials.

identities.name: Singaporean iMessage Users
identities.description: A class of at least 251 individuals in Singapore who were targeted and defrauded by the iMessage courier phishing scam, resulting in losses of over S$1.2 million.

identities.name: DHL
identities.description: A major courier company whose brand and services were impersonated by scammers in the iMessage phishing campaign.

identities.name: NinjaVan
identities.description: A courier company whose brand was impersonated by scammers in the iMessage phishing campaign.

identities.name: SingPost
identities.description: Singapore's national postal service, which was one of the courier companies impersonated by scammers.

identities.name: Singapore Police Force
identities.description: The government agency in Singapore that issued a public advisory on August 5, 2026, to warn about the widespread iMessage phishing scam.

identities.name: Apple
identities.description: The provider of the iMessage platform, which was abused by scammers to deliver phishing messages to victims.

infrastructure.name: Courier Phishing Website
infrastructure.description: Professionally designed, spoofed websites that mimic legitimate courier sites. These sites were used to harvest victims' full credit card details and internet banking credentials under the pretense of paying a small re-delivery fee.
